thread:
devon: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to update metering + dashboard panel for tiered pricing and quota header examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
maya: taking a look. main thing: the billing panel uses count_per_minute but the PR uses `rpm`. can you align the metric name and unit?
devon: good catch. i updated the panel to use `usage.tokens` and changed the aggregation to `tokens/min`. excerpt: ```json
{\"metric\":\"usage.tokens\",\"aggregation\":\"sum\",\"unit\":\"tokens/min\"}
```
kevin: small nit — the SDK snippet shows header `X-Rate-Limit` but our client expects `x-redwood-quota`. examples should use lower-case header and show burst credits.
devon: updated the SDK snippet, PTAL: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
resp = c.generate(prompt='hi', headers={'x-redwood-quota':'tenant=acme;tier=standard'})
```
anna: the pricing tiers table link is broken in the PR — the anchor changed after the pricing revamp. need to update to `/pricing#tier-table-2026`.
maya: also a wording request from legal/product about "soft quota" phrasing — please change any mention of "infinite" or "unlimited" to "soft limit with overage warnings".
devon: will update wording. also added a dashboard screenshot at `assets/metering-panel.png` and attached a small note on expected panel thresholds.
docs-bot: build succeeded for branch docs/metering-panel (CI #1123) — no broken-links detected.
kevin: LGTM aside from the soft-quota wording. once maya signs off we can merge.
maya: approve, thanks devon. :shipit:
devon: merging now. i'll follow up with another tiny PR for embedding quota examples and a short migration note for Dedicated customers about header differences.
